said.text:
Hello,

Thank you for writing about your oak bench (order JKK3DGHNLKWKC5PVX). Natural oil on oak does shift a little from the photos — grain and light both affect the tone, and a piece that reads a little darker is within what we expect for this finish. I'm glad the bench itself is lovely.

You didn't ask for a refund, so I haven't issued one. If the color is a real problem for you, reply and tell me what you'd like us to do. I can consider a modest adjustment up to $150 for a genuine problem. args.body:
Hello,

Thank you for writing about your oak bench (order JKK3DGHNLKWKC5PVX). Natural-oil oak often reads a little darker in the room than it does in photos — grain, oil, and light all shift the color, and that is normal for this finish rather than a defect. Our records show the bench was delivered.

You said it is lovely and only a little darker, so I have not issued a refund. If the color is more of a problem than you can live with, reply with what you would like us to do and we will look at a reasonable next step.

Juniper & Oak
